subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should agent.cli.claude.run.v1 remain a catalog-only internal command, or become a generally invocable plugin node command and supported public contract?
rationale: The branch currently implements both interpretations at once: plugin metadata advertises generic invocation while node.invoke deliberately forbids it, and choosing the permanent owner/API boundary affects plugin compatibility and the security model.

options.title: Keep it catalog-only
options.body: Filter the command from generic invocableCommands and retain sessions.catalog.continue as the only supported gateway entry point.

options.title: Support generic plugin invocation
options.body: Add a typed supported plugin runtime invocation contract with matching authorization, compatibility documentation, and focused tests.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or split the branch until a broader reusable node agent-run protocol is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Keep it catalog-only
recommendation.body: Filter the command from generic invocableCommands and retain sessions.catalog.continue as the only supported gateway entry point.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged catalog work and current feature history make this the strongest available routing candidate for the permanent contract decision.
